clues.text: Esau, back from the field and famished, sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and a stew of these.
Jacob was cooking a red stew of these, and Esau begged for some, which is why he was called Edom.
Shammah son of Agee stood in the middle of a field full of these and struck down the Philistines.
When David fled from Absalom to Mahanaim, Shobi, Machir and Barzillai brought these to him along with beds and basins.
Along with honey, curds and cheese, these were given to David's people, who were hungry and exhausted in the wilderness.
God told Ezekiel to put these in one container with wheat, barley, beans, millet and spelt to make bread.
Ezekiel ate bread made partly from these during the 390 days he lay on his side.
